newsitem.title: USA: Georgia cites reasons for 3Q earnings drop.
newsitem.headline: Georgia cites reasons for 3Q earnings drop.

text.p: Georgia Gulf Corp on Thursday blamed a drop in third quarter earnings on declines in vinyl resin prices and lower production from scheduled maintenance turnarounds at some of its plants.

The chemicals maker said sharp declines in vinyl resin prices brought lower results on the average selling price of its products. Profit margins were lower for all products with the exception of vinyl compounds, the company said.
The company said pricing for nearly all its products was lower this year, particularly for its vinyl products and methanol.

"As we look forward to the fourth quarter, we anticipate some seasonal slowdown with certain products but are hopeful we will see a continuation of good results in aromatics and methanol," the company stated.
The company said however that it expects "a better year ahead" in 1997 as it realizes benefits from its share repurchase program and from added capacity and cost reduction projects.
